description: Notion desktop app on macOS via a use.computer remote sandbox. Notion is distributed as a universal-binary DMG (no Rosetta required) and installed as a drag-and-drop .app at /Applications/Notion.app. The app is gated on a sign-in screen without credentials, so tasks here exercise macOS-native interactions with the running Notion process: launch and process state, window screenshots via the macOS screen capture utility, and app-presence verification. Verifiers use pgrep / lsappinfo / xattr — no AppleScript-over-SSH (TCC blocks it).
